sentences.en: Our teacher is Chinese, and she is very nice.
In the morning we learn to write Chinese characters.
The characters I write are not very good, but the teacher says it doesn't matter.
At four in the afternoon, we go home.

quiz.q: What does the narrator study at school?
What time do they go home in the afternoon?

grammar.p: 在 + place + verb — where you do something
grammar.e: Say where first, then what you do: 在学校学习 = study at school.
grammar.x: 我在学校学习汉语。 — I study Chinese at school.

grammar.e: 不太 softens a negative judgement. Because 太 is fourth tone, 不 is read bú here.
grammar.x: 我写的字不太好。 — The characters I write are not very good.

grammar.p: verb + 的 + noun — a modifier before a noun
grammar.e: A whole phrase can describe a noun if you add 的: 我写的字 = the characters that I write.
grammar.x: 我写的字不太好。 — The characters I write are not very good.
